problem: Platform routing was protected at generation and final-build time, but the canonical live-production shell readback did not explicitly assert the deployed Platform href.
root_cause: The live shell contract verified labels, shell hashes and release markers but treated the Platform label as presence-only.
decision: Promote Platform -> /product to a live production invariant on every shell page, requiring both desktop and mobile anchors and rejecting stale, external or missing targets.
prevention: Every live shell readback verifies at least two visible Platform anchors.
Every live Platform target must resolve on the canonical origin to /product.
A stale /bedrijfsgeheugen target now fails the production readback.
The unit regression proves canonical, stale and missing-counterpart cases.
